explanation: Find the lowest adjacent unequal bits and flip both. The swap preserves the set-bit count and gives the smallest numerical change. Unsigned long long masks preserve all 64 positions on both Windows and Linux.
timeComplexity: O(64), constant time for the unsigned word.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from its public native contract and repository-authored C# algorithm. Existing upstream reference files remain unchanged.
